speaker: Jinpachi Ego
text: Welcome, egoists.

speaker: Jinpachi Ego
text: Japan has never produced a striker who could win a World Cup. Today, we begin fixing that. By destroying most of you.

speaker: Jinpachi Ego
text: I am Jinpachi Ego. For as long as you survive here, mine is the only opinion that matters, and I will give it to you honestly.

speaker: Jinpachi Ego
text: Prefectural final. Eighty-ninth minute. A pass, when there was a shot. You looked at the goal, and then you chose to be liked.

speaker: Jinpachi Ego
text: Cut at sixteen for being “too selfish”. Your academy filed a talent under character flaws. I file it under frightened someone.

speaker: Jinpachi Ego
text: No club, no coach, no shape. My staff flagged you as an anomaly. I flagged you as a test case: what happens to a player who was never taught to fear structure?

speaker: Jinpachi Ego
text: Four assists a week for three seasons. You see more of the pitch than most of this room, and you have spent years donating it to other people’s goals.

speaker: Jinpachi Ego
text: Your sibling’s surname is on the same page as yours. Here, no one’s brother is anything. You are only the name you earn.

speaker: Jinpachi Ego
text: Eleven months of football. Most here have logged eleven years. I selected you anyway: my staff measured how fast you improve, and it frightened them.

speaker: Jinpachi Ego
text: Every goal. In front of three hundred witnesses.

speaker: Jinpachi Ego
text: Good. I hope you digest better than you posture.

speaker: Jinpachi Ego
text: A player who asks for the rubric. Interesting. Most of this room is trying to impress me; you’re trying to solve me.

speaker: Jinpachi Ego
text: Careful: a metric you understand is a metric you can be tempted to cheat.

speaker: Jinpachi Ego
text: Better teammates. How considerate.

speaker: Jinpachi Ego
text: Understand this: the world does not remember who made the striker better. It remembers the striker.

speaker: Jinpachi Ego
text: Nothing. Silence is also an answer, though rarely a good one.

speaker: Jinpachi Ego
text: You froze. I saw it. We’ll find out whether it was fear or calculation.

speaker: Jinpachi Ego
text: Honesty. Expensive and rare.

speaker: Jinpachi Ego
text: Don’t mistake my interest for mercy. A fear you can name is a fear I can use.

speaker: Jinpachi Ego
text: Ha. “Coachability concerns.” The academy meant it as an indictment. I’ve filed it as a feature.

speaker: Jinpachi Ego
text: An anomaly doesn’t answer questions. It is the answer to one.

speaker: Jinpachi Ego
text: You feint with your mouth first. I’ll remember you can.

speaker: Jinpachi Ego
text: Written. Don’t make me regret the ink.

speaker: Jinpachi Ego
text: Then I’ll start the list tomorrow.

speaker: Anri Teieri
text: That’s everyone’s first interview done. Congratulations: you’ve survived being looked at by Ego.

speaker: Anri Teieri
text: One thing about your file.

speaker: Anri Teieri
text: There’s a flag on it: “anomaly”. It doesn’t mean trouble. It means more people will be watching you than you’d like.

speaker: Anri Teieri
text: Some of the coaching staff noted your academy history. Perhaps… don’t sit near the staff table at dinner.

speaker: Anri Teieri
text: Rooms are assigned on the third floor. Go and meet the others. The ones who survive here won’t be the ones who waited to be introduced.

speaker: Sora Kaizuka
text: It hit the post. I— sorry. I’m sorry, {player}. You gave me everything and I—

speaker: Reiji Hasegawa
text: “Too selfish.” That’s what the report says. I read it over the director’s shoulder. Strange word for a forward.

speaker: Reiji Hasegawa
text: You were better than me on the ball, you know. You were just worse at pretending you weren’t.

speaker: Sora Kaizuka
text: {player}…? You got the letter too.

speaker: Sora Kaizuka
text: I almost didn’t come. I kept thinking the invitation was for the miss and not the pass, and then I realised that doesn’t make sense, and then I came anyway.

speaker: Sora Kaizuka
text: I’m sorry again. I know you’re sick of it. I just— I want to be worth the pass.

speaker: Sora Kaizuka
text: …Okay. Okay. Then I’ll stop apologising. Starting now. Starting— sorry.

speaker: Sora Kaizuka
text: No. Starting now.

speaker: Sora Kaizuka
text: I… understand.

speaker: Sora Kaizuka
text: Then I’ll take it. I’ll take it from you. I’ve never taken anything from anyone before.

speaker: Sora Kaizuka
text: I— no. No, I won’t.

speaker: Sora Kaizuka
text: You are doing this on purpose, aren’t you?

speaker: Sora Kaizuka
text: The keeper’s hands. They shifted at the last second. I knew it was too late to change it.

speaker: Sora Kaizuka
text: …Right. Of course. Sorry for— never mind.

speaker: Reiji Hasegawa
text: You look surprised. Don’t be. They send the academy’s sons through the front door. They let you in through the back.

speaker: Reiji Hasegawa
text: For what it’s worth: I didn’t know they were cutting you. I only knew afterwards. I thought you’d want to hear that from me.

speaker: Reiji Hasegawa
text: Careful. People who talk like that usually end up in a box by the gate.

speaker: Reiji Hasegawa
text: I mean that as a courtesy.

speaker: Reiji Hasegawa
text: You can’t eat a position. You have to be given it.

speaker: Reiji Hasegawa
text: …But I’d like to watch you try.

speaker: Reiji Hasegawa
text: …Nobody has ever noticed that.

speaker: Reiji Hasegawa
text: How mature.

speaker: Reiji Hasegawa
text: Don’t mistake courtesy for weakness. I’ll remember you said that.

speaker: Reiji Hasegawa
text: You can’t avoid me forever. We’re the same weight class.

speaker: Meguru Bachira
text: Heyyy. You’re the cage kid, right? The staff say “anomaly”. I say: monster. Same thing but nicer.

speaker: Meguru Bachira
text: Have you got one too? Everyone who plays like us has one. A monster. It lives in the ball.

speaker: Meguru Bachira
text: You mean that. I can tell. Okay. I’m going to hold you to it.

speaker: Meguru Bachira
text: Oooh. Okay.

speaker: Meguru Bachira
text: Then try to catch mine.

speaker: Meguru Bachira
text: Both. That’s the fun part!

speaker: Meguru Bachira
text: I don’t see. I hear. Like the ball’s humming a direction.

speaker: Meguru Bachira
text: Aww. That’s sad. Everybody does.

speaker: Shoei Barou
text: A playmaker. Good. A king needs somebody to carry the ball to the box.

speaker: Shoei Barou
text: You’ll feed me. You’ll be punished if you don’t. That’s all you need to know.

speaker: Shoei Barou
text: Hm. You learn quickly.

speaker: Shoei Barou
text: That’s what a servant is for.

speaker: Shoei Barou
text: You what?

speaker: Shoei Barou
text: …Say it again when you’ve scored in front of me.

speaker: Shoei Barou
text: Careful, passer.

speaker: Shoei Barou
text: Hm.

speaker: Shoei Barou
text: You’ll come to me. They always do.

speaker: Rin Itoshi
text: Another one with a famous name behind them.

speaker: Rin Itoshi
text: Here, it means nothing. Mine either. I intend to make that true.

speaker: Rin Itoshi
text: …Don’t.

speaker: Rin Itoshi
text: Don’t say that as if we’re the same.

speaker: Rin Itoshi
text: Interesting. Most people want to be on the page next to him.

speaker: Rin Itoshi
text: And you’ve never counted how many times they say yours?

speaker: Rin Itoshi
text: …Observant.

speaker: Rin Itoshi
text: Good. Sit far away.

speaker: Rensuke Kunigami
text: Rensuke Kunigami. You were whispering about how long you’d been playing. I overheard.

speaker: Rensuke Kunigami
text: Eleven months? That’s… a lot of ground to make up.

speaker: Rensuke Kunigami
text: I’m not going to pretend it’s fair. But if you want, I’ll show you what I know.

speaker: Rensuke Kunigami
text: Good. That’s the right way to say it.

speaker: Rensuke Kunigami
text: …Fair. I’d do the same.

speaker: Rensuke Kunigami
text: It’s not charity. Charity doesn’t want anything back.

speaker: Rensuke Kunigami
text: Your stance. You stand like a player who thinks the ball is going to hurt him.

speaker: Rensuke Kunigami
text: Strong grip. Good.

speaker: Sora Kaizuka
text: You said it wouldn’t matter again. I’ve been thinking about that. Can we run the finish? Please. No, sorry. Can we.

speaker: Sora Kaizuka
text: You said I’d have to take it from you. So.

speaker: Sora Kaizuka
text: I know where you’d look. The keeper’s hands. That’s what I was staring at when I missed. Nobody told me I could stop.

speaker: Sora Kaizuka
text: Hey. I did some drills on my own. I’m not apologising. I just wanted you to see.

speaker: Sora Kaizuka
text: Left foot… right foot… hit it.

speaker: Sora Kaizuka
text: It went in. It went IN, {player}.

speaker: Sora Kaizuka
text: Again.

speaker: Sora Kaizuka
text: Again!

speaker: Sora Kaizuka
text: The net…

speaker: Sora Kaizuka
text: Oh. The net doesn’t move.

speaker: Sora Kaizuka
text: Okay. Okay. I’ll do it by myself.

speaker: Reiji Hasegawa
text: Settle something for me. A one-on-one. Winner keeps the window seat.

speaker: Reiji Hasegawa
text: You said I wouldn’t have it for long. Let’s see how long.

speaker: Reiji Hasegawa
text: You know my left first touch is dead weight. Don’t pretend you don’t. Let’s see if you can use it.

speaker: Reiji Hasegawa
text: Of course. Smart. Safe.

speaker: Reiji Hasegawa
text: …You got past me. On the left.

speaker: Reiji Hasegawa
text: Too slow. Too wild. They told you that, didn’t they?

speaker: Meguru Bachira
text: You said you’d play with me one day. It’s one day.

speaker: Meguru Bachira
text: You said monsters get eaten. So: catch.

speaker: Meguru Bachira
text: Soooo. Have you got a monster? Show me.

speaker: Meguru Bachira
text: Heehee. There. There it is. Did you hear it? The ball hummed.

speaker: Meguru Bachira
text: Ahhh. You’re serious. Okay. Okay, I like it.

speaker: Meguru Bachira
text: Boo. Okay. Sleep tight, monster.

speaker: Shoei Barou
text: You. Passer. The next ball comes to me.

speaker: Shoei Barou
text: You’ve already picked a side, haven’t you? Servant.

speaker: Shoei Barou
text: Hm.

speaker: Shoei Barou
text: Good servant.

speaker: Shoei Barou
text: You dare.

speaker: Shoei Barou
text: …But you scored. Next time you will give it to me anyway.

speaker: Shoei Barou
text: You looked at me, and then you shot. You lied with your eyes.

speaker: Shoei Barou
text: Do it again and I’ll break your legs. …Do it better and I’ll remember your name.

speaker: Shoei Barou
text: You’re the one who said “every goal.”

speaker: Shoei Barou
text: Including mine?

speaker: Shoei Barou
text: Hahaha. Good. I’ll enjoy watching you try.

speaker: Shoei Barou
text: Careful.

speaker: Shoei Barou
text: You’d serve me?

speaker: Shoei Barou
text: Hm.

speaker: Shoei Barou
text: You’ll answer me on the pitch, then.

speaker: Rin Itoshi
text: Three touches each. Whoever loses the ball first admits it.

speaker: Rin Itoshi
text: Good. Don’t look at the scoreboard. There isn’t one.

speaker: Rin Itoshi
text: Nothing is “just” anything.

speaker: Rin Itoshi
text: Then you’re not as interesting as the name.

speaker: Rensuke Kunigami
text: Stand with your weight on the balls of your feet. Not like you’re afraid it’ll hurt.

speaker: Rensuke Kunigami
text: Better. Again.

speaker: Rensuke Kunigami
text: Not bad for eleven months. Not good either.

speaker: Rensuke Kunigami
text: Suit yourself.

speaker: Jinpachi Ego
text: You asked what we measure. Here is one number: goals per opportunity.

speaker: Jinpachi Ego
text: Now: do you play to the number, or to the goal?

speaker: Jinpachi Ego
text: Careful. A man who games the rubric ends up as a statistic.

speaker: Jinpachi Ego
text: Good. The number was only ever my way of finding out which of you would say that.

speaker: Jinpachi Ego
text: You said you wanted to make people better. I need to know if that’s a plan or an excuse.

speaker: Jinpachi Ego
text: Soon, some of you will be eliminated. Some, by you. What do you do when it’s a friend?

speaker: Jinpachi Ego
text: Your kindness is a luxury. Enjoy it while the selections are still easy.

speaker: Jinpachi Ego
text: Better. A striker who lies to himself about losing is not a striker.
